visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair wearing a white ribbed shirt sits in a room with warm indoor lighting. Behind him is a bookshelf containing small figures, boxes, and books. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing frequently with both hands to emphasize his points. (2) The scene transitions to a recording of a video editing interface on a smartphone, showing multiple video tracks and layers. It then cuts to the man riding a scooter on a bright, sunny road, wearing a black jacket and a silver helmet, looking occasionally at the camera. (3) Visuals alternate between screen recordings of the editing timeline and outdoor travel footage. A wide shot of a green park with buildings in the background is shown, followed by a coastal road and a close encounter with a large gravel truck. The man's talking head appears in a small circular inset. (4) The video returns to the original setting of the man in the room. He continues his explanation, looking focused and calm. Large yellow and black variety-show style captions appear over the lower part of the frame to highlight key phrases.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: List-based: Hook -> Tutorial Explanation -> Practical Demonstration -> Conclusion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to teach viewers how to efficiently create a professional-looking travel vlog by focusing on the 'rough cut' phase. It uses the creator's personal scooter trip footage as a real-world example to demonstrate the logical arrangement of scenes based on chronological order and narrative intent.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The video features the interface of the mobile video editing software CapCut (Jianying) and provides a tutorial on how to use it for 'rough cutting' vlogs, presenting it as an essential tool for the workflow.

high_inference.freeDescribe: A well-produced vertical tutorial video combining talking-head segments with B-roll travel footage and screen recordings. The high density of text overlays and fast-paced editing is typical of modern social media content creators.
